title: Law 3A Isolation: Orthogonal 2->4 Shift Across 42.4-Sigma Valley
intuition: With G = nn.Identity() and a smooth SiLU critic, expands an R^4 target at step 300 from 2 modes (+-1.5 e1) to 4 equidistant orthogonal modes (+-1.5 e1, +-1.5 e2) separated by a 42.4-sigma valley, paired with a frozen control.
failure_mode: Beyond-horizon screening traps particles at the pre-shift symmetric saddle (remaining at 2/4 modes) because local critic forces vanish or cancel across the 42.4-sigma empty valley.
